subject: storytime
title: Chicka Chicka words
about: The lowercase letters of the alphabet race one another up a coconut tree until it bends and they all tumble down, and the grown-up capital letters hurry over to help. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, clapping the beat and naming each letter as it climbs.

book.author: Bill Martin Jr. and John Archambault
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: An alphabet adventure with a bouncy beat and a tree that cannot hold every letter at once.

cards.note: t-r blend; ee says long e
three parts: co-co-nut; the first o says its name: koh-kuh-nut
ch is one part; ck is one sound; the a at the end says uh: chick-uh
tt is one t; two parts: let + ters; the s says z
c-l blend; the i says its name and the b is silent: klime
oo says long oo, like in moon
all regular; n-d at the end
a says aw before ll: fawl
magic e makes i say its name
all regular; m-p at the end
kn says n, the k is silent; ee says long e: nee
oo says long oo; th is one part
ar says ar, like in car
